invariants.rationale: The method accesses items.get(pressedIndex), so items must not be null to avoid NullPointerException.
pressedIndex is compared to -1; it is reasonable to assume -1 may be a sentinel value, so pressedIndex should not be less than -1.
A collection's size should never be negative in Java.
pressedIndex is passed to items.get(pressedIndex) if not -1; it should be less than size to avoid IndexOutOfBoundsException.
